svg.title: SwarmHub: who runs where
svg.desc: The SwarmHub Mac app talks over HTTP, with an access key, to the SwarmHub bridge on a Herdr server. The bridge talks to Herdr Core over a Unix socket; Core runs the agent programs (Claude Code, Codex) in terminals. The agents report back to the bridge through hooks, and the bridge sends events to the app. Core reaches project servers over SSH, and each agent program signs in to its own model provider.
